title: RTOS - Real-Time Linux Simulation Environment
summary: Custom x86 Linux kernel distribution patched with PREEMPT_RT to provide deterministic soft real-time execution for high-frequency simulation loops.
highlights: Configured and tuned PREEMPT_RT kernel patches for low-jitter scheduling on commodity x86 hardware.
Dedicated CPU pinning and real-time thread priority scheduling for 60Hz/100Hz flight physics and I/O polling.
Eliminated non-deterministic latency spikes for mission-critical training devices.
